title: BTS
description: BTS - Battle, Team, Sell。生命偷取 + 语音聊天生存服务器，战斗、组队、交易，体验不一样的 SMP BTS - Battle, Team, Sell. A survival server with Lifesteal and Simple Voice Chat. Fight, team up, and trade in a unique SMP
body:
BTS - Battle, Team, Sell。生命偷取 + 语音聊天生存服务器，战斗、组队、交易，体验不一样的 SMP！
 
英文：
 
BTS - Battle, Team, Sell. A survival server with Lifesteal and Simple Voice Chat. Fight, team up, and trade in a unique SMP experience
 
🎮 BTS 服务器
 
⚔️ Battle | 🤝 Team | 💰 Sell
 
欢迎来到 BTS 服务器！一个充满挑战和乐趣的生存服务器。
 
✨ 服务器特色
 
❤️ 生命偷取系统 (Lifesteal)
 
- 击杀玩家可以获得他们的生命值
- 死亡会失去生命值
- 生命耗尽会被暂时封禁
- 可以通过合成或购买复活
- 紧张刺激的 PvP 体验！
 
🎙️ 近距离语音聊天 (Simple Voice Chat)
 
- 支持近距离语音通话
- 和身边的玩家实时语音交流
- 更沉浸的游戏体验
- 需要安装 Simple Voice Chat 模组
 
🎯 游戏玩法
 
- 生存模式：从零开始，收集资源，建造基地
- PvP 战斗：在战斗中夺取他人的生命值
- 组队合作：和朋友一起探险、建造
- 交易系统：与其他玩家交易物品和资源
- 自由探索：广阔的世界等你发现
 
🌐 服务器信息
 
- 版本：Minecraft 26.2 (Paper)
- 游戏模式：生存
- 难度：简单
- 最大玩家数：20 人
 
📜 服务器规则
 
1. 尊重他人，禁止辱骂和人身攻击
2. 禁止使用作弊和外挂
3. 禁止恶意破坏他人建筑
4. 享受游戏，玩得开心！

 
🎮 BTS Server
 
⚔️ Battle | 🤝 Team | 💰 Sell
 
Welcome to BTS Server! A survival server full of challenges and fun.
 
✨ Server Features
 
❤️ Lifesteal System
 
- Gain hearts by killing other players
- Lose hearts when you die
- Get temporarily banned when you run out of hearts
- Revive yourself through crafting or trading
- Thrilling PvP experience!
 
🎙️ Proximity Voice Chat (Simple Voice Chat)
 
- Proximity-based voice communication
- Talk to players near you in real-time
- More immersive gameplay experience
- Requires Simple Voice Chat mod
 
🎯 Gameplay
 
- Survival Mode: Start from scratch, gather resources, build your base
- PvP Combat: Steal hearts from other players in battle
- Team Up: Explore and build together with friends
- Trading: Trade items and resources with other players
- Free Exploration: A vast world waiting to be discovered
 
🌐 Server Info
 
- Version: Minecraft 26.2 (Paper)
- Game Mode: Survival
- Difficulty: Easy
- Max Players: 20
 
📜 Server Rules
 
1. Be respectful, no harassment or personal attacks
2. No cheats or hacks allowed
3. No malicious destruction of others' builds
4. Have fun and enjoy
